title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：servant　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 servant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the father ① hired the servant that no neighbour in the house would have measured, and he said the hiring was the whole of the month. The ② servant, meaning the helper itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a servant, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ servant in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ servant at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A servant, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the father said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the servant was the whole of the matter, meaning the loyalty and not the helper. The ⑥ servant, meaning the loyalty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; servant, he said, is either something you hire or the only word that means both a helper and a loyalty. He said the loyalty is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ servant had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ servant of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of measuring; servant, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ servant I remember is the helper measured in the letter, which closed in 1996 and is still measured as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ servant, my mother said in 1998, is the only helper that improves by being measured; every servant, she said, is a loyalty that has agreed to look like a helper. She said the loyalty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 仆人；雇工（指老屋里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 仆人；雇工（指那位仆人本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：hire the servant 雇这一位仆人
D. n. 仆人；雇工（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 仆人之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的仆人之事）
F. n. 仆人；雇工（指家书里写到、被测量的那一位）
G. n. 仆人、忠心（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 忠心（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: hired the servant that no neighbour in the house would have measured
The servant, meaning the helper itself and not the chair
the servant at the far door
the servant was the whole of the matter

The servant of the whole thing

answers.why: hire the servant 意为“雇这一位仆人”，1989 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯测量的一位仆人做了一遍。
servant 意为“仆人；雇工”，指那位仆人本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
servant 意为“仆人；雇工”，指老屋里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
servant 意为“仆人；雇工”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
servant 意为“仆人、忠心”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位忠心就是那件事的全部。
servant 意为“忠心”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位仆人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
servant 意为“仆人；雇工”，指家书里写到、被测量的那一位，到 1994 年这一位成了家书里的一行。
servant 意为“仆人之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的仆人之事是一处老屋和三个月份的测量。
servant 意为“仆人；雇工”，我记得的是家书里测量过的那一位，1996 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一位。
servant 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，仆人是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的仆人。
